We have implemented full query state preservation across single-query and bulk restoration from fine-grained persisters on branch `fix/persister-restore-state`:

- **Added [`createPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-d88ur7nx/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L770-L779)**: Exported from [`@tanstack/query-core`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-d88ur7nx/packages/query-core/src/index.ts#L78-L82) (and re-exported by framework adapters) to wrap `{ data, state }` snapshots returned from `options.persister` ([`QueryPersister`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-d88ur7nx/packages/query-core/src/types.ts#L98-L115)).
- **Preserved Full Snapshot State in [`Query.fetch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-d88ur7nx/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L597-L611) & [`Query.restoreState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-d88ur7nx/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L454-L485)**:
  - Restores full `QueryState` metadata (`status` including `'error'`, `error`, `errorUpdateCount`, `errorUpdatedAt`, `fetchFailureCount`, `fetchFailureReason`, `dataUpdateCount`, `dataUpdatedAt`, `isInvalidated`, `fetchMeta`, and infinite query `pages`/`pageParams`) with `fetchStatus: 'idle'`.
  - Avoids converting restored snapshots into normal fetch successes and skips `QueryCache` `onSuccess` and `onSettled` callbacks.
- **Preserved Observer Metadata in [`QueryObserver`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-d88ur7nx/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L101-L108)**:
  - Preserves restored `failureCount`, `failureReason`, `errorUpdatedAt`, `dataUpdatedAt`, `isRefetchError`, and `isStale` in observer results across adapters (`react-query`, `preact-query`, `solid-query`, `svelte-query`, `vue-query`, `angular-query-experimental`) without recomputing fresh values on mount.
- **Updated [`experimental_createQueryPersister`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-d88ur7nx/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L168-L171) & [`restoreQueries`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-d88ur7nx/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L317-L353)**:
  - `persisterFn` returns `createPersisterRestoreResult` so single-query restoration adopts the persisted snapshot state.
  - `restoreQueries` restores full query state in bulk and reconciles persisted snapshots with existing in-memory queries via [`reconcileRestoredQueryState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-d88ur7nx/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L868-L993), merging data freshness (`dataUpdatedAt`) and error freshness (`errorUpdatedAt`) independently.
